{{Quote|There's more at play here than you can guess and my master wants the Mandos out of it.|Yaga Auchs to Hondo Karr about his master's plans|<ref name="Legacy (2006) 41">[[Legacy (2006) 41|''Legacy'' (2006) 41]]</ref>}}
This '''mysterious person''' was the true master of [[Yaga Auchs]]. They wanted to keep the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] out of the [[Sith–Imperial War]] and did so by making Yaga keep all Mandalorians based on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].<ref name="Legacy (2006) 41" />
